S.considerations:

One approach: the ~88 m private drive from MacAlpine Loop. The drive entry is not covered; the first camera view is the motor court.

A.status: Access + emergency response  ·  1 private drive ~88 m (288 ft), ~3.7 m (12 ft) at narrowest  ·  meet at the drive entry  ·  EMS in the motor court  ·  single way out
A.considerations:
Everything arrives by one private drive off MacAlpine Loop: 87.6 m (288 ft), curved, ~3.7 m (12 ft) at its narrowest, trees close on both sides, no pullouts visible.
Meet / ground-guide at the drive entry on MacAlpine Loop. Engines and ladders stage on the loop; no LZ on the parcel (dense canopy).
The paved motor court (~20-25 m) takes an ambulance with a multi-point turn; patient path is front entry (probable) to the court.
Rear yard on foot via the W side of the house to the N lawn, 50.4 m (165 ft). There is no walk-around on the S/E. The drive is the only way out.
A.recommendations:
Back the ambulance up the drive or turn it in the court before loading; keep the drive clear of parked apparatus so the single exit stays open.
Ground-guide large apparatus from the drive entry; agree an LZ with the agency in advance.
Confirm the front-entry location, any gate at the drive entry, and the ~2.5 m step on the W walk route on a site visit.
Add a Knox box / lockbox if none exists (none identifiable in imagery) and post the address number at the drive entry.

F.status: WUI parcel  ·  0 City hydrants within 800 m  ·  fuels against the S / SE walls  ·  single drive through vegetation  ·  no pool or pond visible
F.considerations:
Native ponderosa, juniper and sagebrush surround the parcel; canopy comes within a few metres of the roofline on the S, SE and NW.
The irrigated N and E lawns are the only cleared buffer. The S/SE has no equivalent cleared zone.
No City of Bend hydrant within 800 m and no pool, pond or tank visible: water must come by tender or drafting.
The single drive winds through dense vegetation with no second egress (see A).
F.recommendations:
Plan water supply before arrival (tender shuttle / drafting) and confirm the source with the fire district.
Owner: a 30 ft lean, clean Zone 1 on the S and SE first (thin shrubs, limb up), then open crown spacing in Zone 2.
Owner: check chimney spark arrestors and ember-resistant vents (not determinable from imagery).
Keep the drive corridor limbed up for apparatus clearance (confirm width and height on site).
